name: hotelgrid-dark-factory-demo
description: Self-healing software factory demo: comment-to-fix, cross-service auto-rollback with impact reports, AI cost savings loop. Node control plane + Go services (release controller, finops, LLM gateway, loadgen).

scripts.test: node --experimental-sqlite --no-warnings --test test/*.test.mjs && npm run test:app && npm run test:go
scripts.test:app: for v in 1.8.0 1.9.0-rc1; do VERSION_FILE=app/services/hvac-optimizer/versions/$v.mjs node --test app/services/hvac-optimizer/test/*.test.mjs || exit 1; done
scripts.test:go: cd go && go vet ./... && go test -race ./...
scripts.parity:go: node scripts/go-parity-vectors.mjs && cd go && go test ./internal/
scripts.test:adapter: cd go/claude-adapter && go vet . && go test -race .
